episodes.title: Es solo sexo
episodes.summary: A law professor overhears her husband in a suspicious phone conversation, and later visits her recently divorced friend, who drags her to a nightclub.

episodes.title: Una última noche de pasión
episodes.summary: Alma tries to set boundaries with Darío, and later walks in on a scene that supports her suspicions about Leonardo. Zoe questions her sexual identity.

episodes.title: Eso que los normales llaman amor
episodes.summary: When forensic evidence suggests Brenda had just met with a lover, the police focus their efforts on identifying him. Darío gets Alma to open up to him.

episodes.title: Pero el amor, esa palabra
episodes.summary: Alma reveals her lover's name to Esteban, who pays him a visit. Darío finds an upsetting photo in his mom's room. Zoe tries to figure out who Animus is.

episodes.title: ¿Qué sabes acerca de Darío Guerra?
episodes.summary: At the hotel, Darío spies on the anniversary celebration. Esteban digs deeper into Daríos's background and finds a connection to an old murder case.

episodes.title: Extrañado Los Viejos Tiempos?
episodes.summary: Esteban shows Alma a case file. Zoe follows a GPS signal in hopes of finding Animus. Security video footage reveals the last person who visited Brenda.

episodes.title: Te Metiste Con La Mujer Equivocada
episodes.summary: Flashbacks reveal the start of Lucinda's illness. To test a theory Esteban has, Alma follows his instructions and asks Darío to meet her at a motel.

episodes.title: El Corazón Delator
episodes.summary: Alma has second thoughts about leading Darío into Esteban's trap and starts to panic. Meanwhile, Leonardo begins to suspect his wife is cheating on him.

episodes.title: Un Perverso Juego De Espejos
episodes.summary: Leonardo orders an exhumation. A flashback reveals the rest that transpired between Esteban and Darío. Zoe receives a surprise visitor at school.

episodes.title: Esa Instantánea Muerte Es Bella...
episodes.summary: Zoe is taken on a mysterious outing. A clue at Darío's shop leads Alma to a horrifying realization. Esteban's review of the security videos pays off.

episodes.title: Nada Es Lo Que Parece
episodes.summary: Evidence found at the picnic site spurs Leonardo to hunt down Darío. Later, after begging Alma not to air their dirty laundry, he suffers a breakdown.

episodes.title: Nos Hemos Equivocado Tanto
episodes.summary: Esteban asks Vallejo to steal police evidence. Leonardo makes an admission to his brother, and recalls his final meeting with Brenda at her home.

episodes.title: Tú Sólo Fuiste Una Inocente Victima
episodes.summary: A gruesome find is made. Esteban gets hold of Leonardo's phone records and shows them to Alma. Zoe detects Animus's phone signal and zeros in on it.

episodes.title: Dos Verdades Y Una Mentira
episodes.summary: The police apprehend a suspect carrying the evidence bag from Brenda's case. Alma demands answers from Darío. Leonardo's medical test results come back.

episodes.title: Nunca Hablamos De Amor
episodes.summary: Lucinda insists she's owed money. García reviews the security videos and gets suspicious. Leonardo reveals what happened the last time he saw Brenda.

episodes.title: Apocalipsis 21:8... El Fuego Es Encendido En Su Ira
episodes.summary: The man who stole the evidence related to Brenda's case tells García who hired him. Darío remembers where Esteban held him captive and returns there.

episodes.title: Matamos Lo Que Amamos
episodes.summary: Zoe makes a confession to her mom. On the run, Leonardo calls Esteban for help. García obtains an audio recording from the last phone call Brenda made.

episodes.title: La Respuesta Siempre Estuvo Ahi...
episodes.summary: An unexpected encounter answers Alma's lingering questions about the past weeks. García receives forensic results from the textile factory explosion.

episodes.title: Eros y Psique
episodes.summary: Esteban is released from prison. A mysterious woman named Lys joins Alma's support group. A letter in the mail brings shocking news about Darío.

episodes.title: De algo así no se escapa nunca
episodes.summary: Alma decides to warn Julieta about Darío and ends up bumping into him. At her bachelorette party, Julieta receives an eerie text and a tragedy occurs.

episodes.title: Nadie puede huir de sí mismo
episodes.summary: Detective Montaño takes the lead in Julieta's case. Zoe requests a favor of her friend at the morgue. Alma asks Lys about her connection to Darío.

episodes.title: El otro
episodes.summary: After having a conversation with Leonardo, Íñigo starts suspecting Darío. Then, crucial evidence found on the roof turns Darío into the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Caminar sobre las brasas
episodes.summary: When Darío insists that someone is impersonating him, a distrustful Alma reaches out to Esteban to try to unearth his past and confirm her doubts.

episodes.title: Siempre fuiste mi espejo
episodes.summary: Alma spots Darío's alleged doppelgänger. Julieta's cellphone is found. Worried about her mom, Zoe orchestrates an intervention with Leonardo and Mónica.

episodes.title: Un cóctel peligroso
episodes.summary: Esteban and Montaño keep collaborating to crack the case. A video on Julieta's cellphone turns Alma into a suspect in the police investigation.

episodes.title: No creas nada de lo que escuches
episodes.summary: While Alma and Darío are on the run looking for Lucinda's suitcase, Esteban plants a microphone in Montaño's office and sets out to find them.

episodes.title: Te has convertido en tu peor enemiga
episodes.summary: Esteban resorts to an aggressive method to help Alma. A video taken on Darío's 18th birthday reveals a shocking truth about his relationship with Lys.

episodes.title: Cada quien lee su propia historia
episodes.summary: Darío confronts Lys. Zoe goes to Mau's apartment to review Julieta's forensic report. Alma and Esteban focus on uncovering Lys' involvement in the case.

episodes.title: ¿Quién #%& eres en verdad?
episodes.summary: Montaño interrogates Alma, Darío, Lys and Leonardo. Íñigo digs deeper into Lys and Alberto's past. Daríos alleged doppelgänger shows up at Alma's house.

episodes.title: Los mellizos
episodes.summary: A photograph found in Lucinda's suitcase takes the case in a different direction. New incriminating photos from the bachelorette party emerge.

episodes.title: Un perfecto triángulo insoportable
episodes.summary: Montaño investigates the bank account in Andorra. Zoe and Karina reach a breaking point. Esteban comes face to face with the fake Darío.

episodes.title: Siempre fuiste tú
episodes.summary: Montaño confronts Lys with the piling evidence against her. Suspicious of Darío, Alma sneaks into his hotel room and comes to a chilling realization.

episodes.title: Enfrentar la oscuridad...
episodes.summary: Past and present come to a head as Alma decides to face the truth, however dark it may be, of what happened on that fateful night in the hotel.
